title: 第一章 打你就打你第二章 哎呀呀谢谢你哦
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
“抽点血而已，又不是要她的命，至于这么拼命挣扎吗？”耳边传来男人烦躁的声音。
“贺少。”一道女声响起，带着几分小心翼翼的试探，“已经抽了400ml，以唐小姐的体质……再抽下去会出事的。”
“晚意那边还要用多少血？”
“温小姐那边已经够了。”护士以为自己这么说，就不用继续抽了。
岂料，男人沉默两秒，又坚定道：“再抽200ml备用。”
只有唐斩月知道怕了，以后才不会对晚意乱来。
护士不敢不听，只能着手准备针管和血袋。
唐斩月眉头皱紧，谁这么大胆子敢抽她的血给别人备用？活的不耐烦了！
察觉胳膊被人按住，她神色一冷，淡绿色的精神力弥漫而出。
下一秒，按着她的人轰然跪下，倒在地上人事不省。
缩在角落的护理机器人立刻动起来，大眼睛里放出蓝光，给地上的人做身体检测。
唐斩月坐起来，揉着刺痛的脑袋，双眼放空的盯着小机器人。
搞什么啊，才一下就精神力透支，她什么时候这么脆弱了？
她下意识催动木系异能修复精神海，然后震惊地发现，这特么根本不是她身体啊！
唐斩月后知后觉地想起来，她已经拉着整个基地的异能者同归于尽了，那种强度的能量爆炸，即便金刚不坏也得炸成灰。
所以现在的情况是，已经变成鬼的她，刚好占了人家死后还没凉透的身体？
“复活了啊……”唐斩月喃喃自语，忽然乐了，“贼老天总算是办了件人事，就是这身体太弱了。”
不过没关系，花点时间用异能和精神力好好温养，早晚能变得跟她之前一样强！
“唐斩月！”身侧传来带着怒气的低吼声。
唐斩月慢悠悠转头，疑惑地看向男人——这人谁？

身高腿长，长相很帅，一头灰发，发尾却是白色的。
这种品质的帅哥，她以前若见过，绝对不会忘。
啊！她反应过来，这应该是原主认识的人。
然后她神色严肃地盯住男人的脸，屏息以待。
一秒，两秒……无事发生。诶？怎么还没触发记忆！
唐斩月有点懵，这跟小说里写的不一样啊！她啧了声，将注意力放回眼前的问题上，“就是你想抽我600ml的血？”
如果感应没错，原主就是死于失血过多。
这么脆弱的身体，少一点血都能晕过去，一下抽400毫升，这不纯粹是谋杀吗！
贺兰逸沉声道：“这是你欠晚意的。”
酸涩、痛恨的情绪猛然爆发，让唐斩月不适地按了按心口，是原主残留的情绪。
唐斩月叹气，在心底默默道：既然占了你的身体，从今以后我就是你。你之前遭受的委屈，承受的不公，我都会分毫不差地从你仇人身上讨回来。
得了承诺，那缕情绪十分大胆地融入了她的灵魂中。
自此，唐斩月的灵魂才真正与这具身体彻底融合。
再抬头看贺兰逸，她眼里已经完全没了对帅哥的欣赏，只有满满的厌恶。
身体在木系异能的滋养下恢复了一点，唐斩月站起来，一边走向贺兰逸一边活动手腕和手掌。
贺兰逸仗着身高，居高临下道：“今天不管你怎么求我，这200ml的血都必须……”
content_en:
"It's just to draw some blood, it's not to kill her, why are you struggling so hard?" A man's irritable voice came to my ears.
"Young Master He." A female voice sounded, with a hint of cautious probing, "I have already smoked 400ml. With Miss Tang's physique... if I smoke any more, something will happen."
"How much more blood does Wanyi need to use?"
"Miss Wen's side is enough." The nurse thought that if she said this, she would not need to continue pumping.
Unexpectedly, the man was silent for two seconds and then said firmly: "Pull another 200ml for later use."
Only Tang Zhanyue knew that he was afraid, so he would not mess with Wanyi in the future.
The nurse didn't dare not listen, so she could only prepare syringes and blood bags.
Tang Zhanyue frowned. Who was so bold as to draw her blood and give it to others? I am so impatient!
When she noticed someone was holding her arm down, her expression turned cold, and light green spiritual power filled the air.
The next second, the person holding her down suddenly knelt down and fell to the ground unconscious.
The nursing robot huddled in the corner immediately moved, its big eyes emitted blue light, and it performed a physical examination on the people on the ground.
Tang Zhanyue sat up, rubbed his stinging head, and stared at the little robot with empty eyes.
What the hell? She was so mentally exhausted right away. When did she become so fragile?
She subconsciously activated the wood power to repair the spiritual sea, and then she was shocked to find that this was not her body at all!
Tang Zhanyue later remembered that she had dragged all the superpowers in the base to death together. An energy explosion of that intensity would blow even an indestructible King Kong into ashes.
So the current situation is that she, who has turned into a ghost, just happens to occupy someone's body that has not yet cooled down after death?
"Resurrected..." Tang Zhanyue murmured to himself, suddenly happy, "God has finally done something for me, but my body is too weak."
But it doesn't matter, take some time to use your supernatural powers and mental power to nurture her, and sooner or later she will become as strong as she was before!
"Tang Zhanyue!" An angry growl came from beside him.
Tang Zhanyue slowly turned his head and looked at the man in confusion - who is this man?
He is tall, has long legs, and looks very handsome. He has gray hair with white ends.
If she had seen a handsome guy of this quality before, she would never forget him.
ah! She realized that this was someone the original owner knew.
Then she stared at the man's face seriously, waiting with bated breath.
One second, two seconds... nothing happens. Eh? Why hasn’t the memory been triggered yet?
Tang Zhanyue was a little confused. This was different from what was written in the novel! She clicked her tongue and returned her attention to the problem at hand, "You want to draw 600ml of my blood?"
If the induction is correct, the original owner died of excessive blood loss.
With such a fragile body, even a little bit of blood can make you faint. To draw 400 ml in one go, isn’t this pure murder?
He Lanyi said in a deep voice: "This is something you owe me late."
The sour and hateful emotions suddenly broke out, making Tang Zhanyue press his heart uncomfortably. They were the remaining emotions of the original owner.
Tang Zhanyue sighed and said silently in his heart: Since I have taken over your body, I am you from now on. I will take back the grievances and injustices you have suffered from your enemies to the exact same degree.
With the promise, that emotion merged boldly into her soul.
From then on, Tang Zhanyue's soul truly merged with this body.
Looking up at He Lanyi again, her eyes had completely lost her admiration for the handsome guy, only full of disgust.
After his body recovered a little under the nourishment of the wood element, Tang Zhanyue stood up and moved his wrists and palms while walking towards He Lanyi.
Relying on his height, He Lanyi said condescendingly: "No matter how you beg me today, these 200ml of blood must..."
